pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. The pronoun SHE. Two complete standing adults. A man on the left wearing a light gray shirt extends his arm and points his index finger sideways at a woman on the right wearing a bright green top and blue trousers. Woman faces the viewer, his finger clearly targets her across the gap. Both whole bodies and simple shoes, no arrows or symbols. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
